name: Lusso Auto
aboutUs:
Lusso Auto is Cape Town's boutique supercar specialist, offering carefully selected sports, luxury and collector vehicles. Founded by industry professionals with experience at Mercedes-Benz, BMW, Maserati and Ferrari, every vehicle is hand-selected for provenance, condition and driving enjoyment. We don't simply sell cars—we curate collections and build long-term relationships with enthusiasts throughout South Africa.

Every Lusso Auto vehicle is inspected, road tested and honestly represented. If a vehicle has cosmetic imperfections or modifications, we disclose them upfront.
